alias-of:aija_39>ai_36@12c605.note: Parallel lists: Michmash, Aija, Bethel (Neh 11:31) match Michmas, Bethel and Ai (Ezra 2:27-28). Identity is inferred, not stated.

alias-of:beth-azmaveth_192>azmaveth_129@.note: Parallel lists: Azmaveth (Ezra 2:24) and Bethazmaveth (Neh 7:28) both give 42 men, between Anathoth and Kiriath-jearim. Identity inferred, not stated.

alias-of:gate_of_ephraim_438>gate_of_eph.note: Both entries are the one phrase 'the gate of Ephraim' (8:16; 12:39). The text names no other gate by that name. Identity inferred.

alias-of:kiriath-arim_698>kiriath-jearim.note: Parallel lists: Kirjatharim (Ezra 2:25) and Kirjathjearim (Neh 7:29) each give the same three towns and 743 men. Identity inferred.

alias-of:michmas_792>michmash_793@59c3fa.note: Parallel lists: Michmas (Ezra 2:27; Neh 7:31) and Michmash (Neh 11:31) sit among Bethel and Ai. Identity inferred, not stated.

alias-of:pool_691>siloam_1096@0b1bd2.note: King's pool by the fountain gate (2:14) and pool of Siloah by the king's garden (3:15) seem to be one pool. Identity inferred, not stated.

date:dedication-of-the-wall@eaf0dd.note: The text does not date the dedication. Neh 2:1 gives Artaxerxes' twentieth year; 6:15 gives wall completion. The BC year needs outside dating of that reign.

occurred-at:esther-becomes-queen>susa_11.note: Esth 2:8 brings Esther to the king's house at Shushan the palace; 2:16-17 she is taken into it and made queen.

occurred-at:esther-saves-her-people>susa.note: Esther's petition (8:3-8) is set in the palace. Only the decree is placed at Shushan the palace (8:14).

occurred-at:nehemiah-rebuilds-the-walls>.note: Nehemiah was in Shushan only when he heard of the ruin (1:1). He rebuilt the wall at Jerusalem (2:11; 6:15).

part-of:broad_wall_258>jerusalem_636@4a0.note: Neh 3:8: they fortified Jerusalem 'unto the broad wall'. Neh 12:38: the procession runs along the wall to it.

part-of:dung_gate_346>jerusalem_636@9658.note: Neh 3:14 has the dung gate repaired as part of the wall; Neh 12:31 has the procession go toward it on the wall.

part-of:east_gate_349>jerusalem_636@e5d6.note: Neh 3:29 names Shemaiah as keeper of the east gate, among the wall repairers. The text does not say the gate itself is on the wall.

part-of:gate_miphkad_863>jerusalem_636@2.note: Neh 3:31: wall repair runs 'over against the gate Miphkad' to the going up of the corner. The gate is on the wall.

part-of:gate_of_the_fountain_428>jerusal.note: Neh 3:15: the gate of the fountain is repaired with its wall. Neh 12:37: the procession goes up at the fountain gate on the wall.

part-of:gate_of_the_valley_1195>jerusale.note: Neh 3:13: the valley gate is repaired with the wall. Nehemiah goes out by it while surveying the broken wall (2:13).

part-of:horse_gate_582>jerusalem_636@aef.note: Neh 3:28: priests repaired the wall 'from above the horse gate', each over against his house.

part-of:old_gate_439>jerusalem_636@251b7.note: Text places 'the old gate' on the wall (3:6; 12:39). The name Yeshanah is not in this text, so the naming link is unchecked.

part-of:prison_gate_441>jerusalem_636@5d.note: Neh 12:39: the procession stands 'in the prison gate' on the wall. The label Gate of the Guard is not in this text.

part-of:sheep_gate_1070>jerusalem_636@34.note: Neh 3:1: the sheep gate is built and sanctified, with its wall; Neh 12:39: the procession stands at the sheep gate on the wall.

part-of:tower_1177>jerusalem_636@dd3950.note: Neh 3:1 and 12:39 name 'the tower of Hananeel' as a point on the city wall.

part-of:tower_1179>jerusalem_636@008575.note: Text places 'the tower of Meah' on the wall (3:1; 12:39). The word Hundred is not in this text, so the naming link is unchecked.

part-of:tower_1180>jerusalem_636@059643.note: Neh 3:11 and 12:38 name 'the tower of the furnaces' on the wall. Ovens is a rendering of furnaces.

part-of:water_gate_1230>jerusalem_636@2e.note: Neh 3:26 and 12:37 place the water gate on the wall toward the east.

participated-in:darius_978>second-temple.note: Darius issues the search and decree and orders funding (6:1, 6:8, 6:12). 6:14 says the work was done by his commandment. Taking part is inferred from decree, not from building.

participated-in:eliashib_1100>nehemiah-r.note: Neh 3:1: 'Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests, and they builded the sheep gate.'

participated-in:ezra_1245>dedication-of-.note: Neh 12:36: 'Ezra the scribe before them' leads a company in the dedication procession. The Ezra named in 12:33 is not identified.

participated-in:hanani_1382>nehemiah-reb.note: The text has Hanani bringing news from Judah (1:2). After the wall was built he is given charge of Jerusalem (7:2). He is not shown building.

participated-in:nehemiah_2172>dedication.note: Neh 12:31, 38, 40: Nehemiah leads one company of thanksgiving on the wall and stands with them at the house of God.

partner-of:ahasuerus_117>esther_1343@3c2.note: Taken into the king's house and made queen instead of Vashti (2:16-17). Queen implies wife, but the text never says 'married'.
